initialExam.title: Army Agniveer Technical 2026
initialExam.description: Agniveer Technical entry for Indian Army recruiting young candidates in technical trades including electronics, mechanical, and IT. Candidates serve for 4 years under the Agnipath scheme.
initialExam.eligibility: 12th pass with Physics, Chemistry, Math with 50% aggregate
initialExam.syllabus: General Knowledge, General Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, English.
initialExam.examPattern: CEE (Common Entrance Exam): 50 questions, 100 marks, 60 minutes. Objective type.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Online Registration → Rally (Physical/Medical) → CEE Written Exam → Merit List
initialExam.jobRole: Agniveer (Technical) in Indian Army for 4-year service
initialExam.careerGrowth: Agniveer → 25% retained as regular soldiers → Lance Naik → Naik → Havildar → JCO.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit joinindianarmy.nic.in 2. Register 3. Apply online 4. Attend rally 5. Appear for CEE

salaryRange.description: Agniveer package (30% contribution to Seva Nidhi fund)

initialExam.perks: Seva Nidhi: ₹11.71 lakh on completion, Risk/Hardship allowance, Medical, Canteen, Free rations
